title: YouCoded name and icon ideas: pick what you like

steps.path: Website header, app, everywhere the name is written
steps.headline: Which ways of writing YouCoded do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Each is shown big, in today's website header, and in three other themes (bottom row) to show it still works when the colours change.

variants.label: W1 DM Sans, bold
variants.summary: Today's site font, cleaned up: "You" in the theme colour.

variants.label: W2 DM Sans, lowercase
variants.summary: Same font, softer in lowercase.

variants.label: W3 Comfortaa
variants.summary: The Cotton Candy theme's own font: round, airy.

variants.label: W4 Nunito, extra bold
variants.summary: The Meadow Mist theme's font: rounded but sturdy.

variants.label: W5 Fredoka
variants.summary: Bubbly, matches the mascot's soft corners.

variants.label: W6 Baloo, lowercase
variants.summary: Chunky and friendly, like a sticker.

variants.label: W7 Quicksand
variants.summary: Light and rounded; the quietest option.

variants.label: W8 Bricolage
variants.summary: A bit of quirk in the letter shapes; still clean.

variants.label: W9 Serif "You"
variants.summary: "You" in a soft italic serif, "Coded" in the site font: the "yours" message, written in.

variants.label: W10 Wide capitals
variants.summary: Today's header idea (all caps), redone in one wide font.

variants.label: W11 Gradient
variants.summary: DM Sans with a fill that runs from the theme colour into pink.

variants.label: W12 Pixel
variants.summary: For game-style themes; reads as playful.

steps.headline: Which ways of putting the name and mascot together do you like?
steps.notice: Shown with the plain bold lettering (W1) so only the combination changes. The mascot is whichever theme is on: the Cotton Candy mascot at the top, then the other themes' mascots underneath.

variants.label: L1 Mascot tile + name
variants.summary: Today's header, simplified: the theme's mascot in a glass tile, then the name. No "Assistant" or tagline.

variants.label: L2 Mascot + name, no tile
variants.summary: The mascot stands free next to the name.

variants.label: L3 Mascot is the "o"
variants.summary: The mascot's body takes the place of the first "o".

variants.label: L4 Eyes in both "o"s
variants.summary: Both "o"s become the mascot's rounded head with its two eyes.

variants.label: L5 Peeking over
variants.summary: The mascot peeks over the top of the name.

variants.label: L6 Sitting on the name
variants.summary: The mascot sits on top of the "C", feet on the letter.

variants.label: L7 Stacked
variants.summary: Mascot above, name below. For the app's welcome screen, splash and social posts.

variants.label: L8 Name in a glass pill
variants.summary: The name sits in a glass pill, with the mascot popping out of its left end.

steps.headline: Which app icon ideas do you like?
steps.notice: All use the mascot from today's app icon. Small sizes on the left are real pixels, the way the taskbar shows them.

variants.label: A1 Today
variants.summary: The current icon, for comparison.

variants.label: A2 Purple tile
variants.summary: Same mascot, on the site's purple instead of pale lilac: easier to spot in a taskbar.

variants.label: A3 Sky tile
variants.summary: The website's Cotton Candy sky as the background.

variants.label: A4 Close-up face
variants.summary: Zoomed in on the mascot's face so its eyes stay clear when the icon is small.

variants.label: A5 Peeking up
variants.summary: The mascot rises from the bottom edge and waves.

variants.label: A6 "Y" with mascot
variants.summary: A big "Y" for YouCoded, the mascot sitting in its fork.

variants.label: A7 "yc" + mascot
variants.summary: Lowercase "yc" with the mascot peeking over the letters.

variants.label: A8 Glass tile
variants.summary: A frosted glass tile, like the mascot tiles across the top of the website.

variants.label: A9 No tile
variants.summary: Just the mascot, no square behind it.

variants.label: A10 Follows your theme
variants.summary: The icon swaps to your theme's mascot and colours. The default is the purple tile; these are other themes.

steps.path: The little icon in a browser tab
steps.headline: Which browser-tab icons do you like?
steps.notice: The tab icon is drawn at 16 pixels, so it's shown real size in light and dark browsers, and magnified so you can see what survives.

variants.label: F1 Today
variants.summary: Purple square with the flat white mascot (squint eyes).

variants.label: F2 Same as app icon
variants.summary: The app icon's purple tile, so the tab and the taskbar match.

variants.label: F3 Mascot, no tile
variants.summary: Just the glossy mascot.

variants.label: F4 Face only
variants.summary: The mascot's face filling a purple circle: two eyes read even at tab size.

variants.label: F5 "Y" in purple
variants.summary: A white "Y" on the purple tile.

variants.label: F6 "yc" in purple
variants.summary: Lowercase "yc" on the purple tile.

variants.label: F7 Follows the site theme
variants.summary: The tab icon changes with the site's theme, using that theme's mascot.
